meta.title: WheatFHB Atlas
meta.assembly: IWGSC Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 (v1.1 annotation convention)
meta.scope: bread wheat nuclear chromosomes 1A–7D; alien segments kept separate
meta.coverageNote: The public Zheng et al. Table S1 contains 624 chromosome-tagged rows, while the article reports 625 collected original QTL. The atlas preserves the 624 publicly mappable records and reports the discrepancy instead of inventing a row.
meta.coordinateNote: All chromosome drawings use RefSeq v1.0 lengths. Reversed left/right coordinates in legacy tables are normalized with a flag. Alien introgressions and genetic-only intervals are not forced onto Chinese Spring physical coordinates.
meta.impactNote: Impact factor is a journal-level metric with a displayed year and source; it is not an evidence-quality score. Missing values are left blank.
